beats.story: "Due to your extreme misconduct and personal breaches with your colleagues, we're going to dismiss you from your position within Supershops Incorporated, effective immediately." Something in me breaks with the words "personal breaches." I have no fight left. This was always going to happen. I shouldn't have spoken to anyone. I stare at my lap and give a small nod. "Security and I will escort you to your workstation to clear your belongings and ensure your safe exit from the building. Please turn in your access card and ID card to me." I pull the lanyard from my pocket and slide it over. Our fingertips touch for a second. I immediately pull my hand away.
beats.story_cn: “鉴于你极端失职及私德有亏，我们决定立即解除你在超级商店公司的职务。”听到“私德有亏”四字时，体内有什么东西碎了。我已无力抗争。这一天终会到来。我不该与任何人交谈。我盯着膝盖，轻轻点头。“安保人员会护送你到工位收拾物品，并确保你安全离开大楼。请将门禁卡和工牌交给我。”我从口袋抽出挂绳递过去。指尖相触的一刹那，我猛地缩回手。
